candidates.contract: Versioned Express REST and OpenAPI schemas share domain operations and generated client contracts without Fastify or duplicate mutation logic.
Strict client, shared, and server boundaries are enforceable without a directory or framework rewrite.
Vue, Vuetify, and scoped semantic CSS remain the sole application theme, focus, localization, and responsive authority.
Reproduced defects are fixed in Vuetify surfaces and core journeys remain responsive, keyboard-complete, and accessible.
Session-scoped password grants compose with private ownership, assets, history, search, APIs, rate limits, and non-disclosure.
Editor-native controls preserve canonical Markdown through parse, edit, serialize, render, history, and source fallback.
Versioned strict extension envelopes retain canonical source, sanitized fallbacks, authorization, consent, lifecycle, and migration safety.
Revision-bound approval transitions are authorized, atomic, audited, stale-safe, recoverable, and available through responsive inboxes.
History diff, source, download, branch, and optimistic restore preserve canonical content and private-page authorization.
One deterministic resource-access policy covers private visibility, page rules, derived resources, and non-disclosure.
Authenticated durable Markdown rooms preserve local edits across reconnect, authorization changes, process loss, and multi-instance delivery.
Readable-page watches use transactional events and idempotent durable delivery with permission-loss cleanup.
Threat- and cost-scoped limits use durable counters, trusted proxy identity, deterministic 429 responses, and operable recovery.
Provider changes retain broad compatibility and share callback, token, profile, error, and regression contracts.
PostgreSQL leases, idempotent handlers, transactional outbox, bounded retries, recovery, and administrator visibility own background work.
Registry changes preserve exact canonical bytes and rerender derived output through bounded recoverable jobs.
Every asset render, download, and range request uses central page/asset authorization and storage abstractions.
Redirects prevent loops, preserve authorization and private non-disclosure, and retain editor parity.
Unknown databases are rejected before writes while recognized Wiki.js 2 and tsEpistle PostgreSQL sources upgrade without ledger reset.
Current parser limits reject oversized inputs deterministically without format regressions.
Express serves the Vite application/setup manifests with immutable assets and production runtime proof.
Parent expansion and child-to-parent editing are bounded, authorized, persisted, responsive, and keyboard accessible.
Virtual folders do not conflict with exact page paths and every real collision fails atomically before writes.
Useful administrator utilities use allowlisted operations while JWK endpoints remain until a versioned external migration is published.
Styling tokens are introduced only through the authoritative Vuetify and scoped page-content design system.
Reproducible multi-architecture images, bundles, charts, SBOMs, provenance, and manifests identify one revision.
Each direct dependency change proves current need, behavior, supply chain, license, build, runtime, and rollback independently.
Separate manifests are accepted only after enforceable imports, explicit exports, and measured build/install gains prove one clean package graph.
A disposable isolated repository must materially beat typed Knex while preserving one migration and transaction authority.
A per-extension lazy runtime is retained only if it beats the native controller on correctness, accessibility, transfer, and maintenance.
Supported Wiki.js 2 and tsEpistle PostgreSQL sources upgrade, restore, roll back, and operate across the declared server floor before unused adapters are removed cleanly.
Dynamic requester-time authorization remains authoritative; a rebuildable visibility-neutral projection is accepted only after measured budget failure and parity proof.
Administrators configure one bounded Markdown notice; readers receive sanitized content above every page; malformed persisted settings fail closed.

Mature storage targets retain data continuity while configuration is validated before writes, actions are allowlisted and observable, and disk paths remain inside configured roots; WIP multisite content routing and database offload remain rejected until migration and rollback are proven.

S3-compatible and Azure targets apply one normalized prefix to pages and assets, locale renames address source and destination exactly once, copy sources are encoded, and authentication and storage secrets remain write-only; Scarlett's WIP provider replacement and multisite content delivery remain rejected.
Highlight and definition-list syntax match editor preview and server rendering, while optional tab heading levels enter the table of contents and reveal the correct panel before scrolling.

Crowdin upload automation is added only with an owned project, repository secret, authoritative locale source path, and a release workflow that cannot fail unrelated builds when translation infrastructure is unavailable.

The existing locale installer, namespace configuration, locale-scoped routes and selectors, and bundled-English fallback remain authoritative; Scarlett's Fastify, Drizzle, alias, and force-prefix implementation is not transplanted.

Authorized editors manage UUID-backed translation sets with one page per locale, atomic set merges, safe unlinking, and relation-aware language switching; unrelated Scarlett scheduler, tag-cache, and editor-preview changes remain governed by the fork's existing implementations.

Site navigation remains an explicit administrator-owned tree rather than an automatic page index, so redirect-specific browse flags and a toggle on the incomplete Scarlett redirect editor add no fork behavior.

Vuetify semantic theme colors, numeric system totals, database version metadata, and hidden unfinished social controls already satisfy the portable fixes; Scarlett-specific Tailwind, block-tab, and Monaco preview patches are not copied.

The fork retains its explicit site-wide asset folder tree rather than treating page paths as asset folders; Scarlett's pending pasted-upload destination is therefore not transplanted. Save commands are made single-flight, while the fork's synchronous editor-store writes already avoid Scarlett's delayed-save race.

System jobs remain code-defined and are re-registered in memory on every boot; storage target activity timestamps are refreshed at a bounded cadence so an unchanged healthy or failing outcome still proves recent use without adding a database write to every operation.

Editor preview and persisted rendering share one safe fence parser; titles use semantic figure captions, renumbering and merged highlight ranges use Prism's native metadata, malformed ranges stay bounded, and actual source-line counts fix Scarlett's two-line off-by-one case.

The fork's administrator-owned navigation tree, responsive browse/custom sidebar, Vuetify search surface, and locale namespaces remain authoritative; Scarlett's path-specific Quasar navigation modes, Tailwind token, and search-panel patch do not map to these surfaces.

Desktop and compact Markdown toolbars insert a valid abbreviation definition, select the term for immediate replacement, preserve surrounding text on its own lines, and match the already-enabled preview and server abbreviation renderer.

Git storage aborts interrupted merges and rebases before use, resolves ordinary rebase conflicts toward the authoritative remote without wedging the index, reattaches unrelated replacement histories while keeping newer wiki files, and persists the default repository path in both production image variants.

The fork retains its functional SSL status, redirection, and certificate-renewal administration. An MCP page is added only with a real server, key lifecycle, permissions, and observable state; Scarlett's permanently disabled placeholder is not shipped.

Verification and password-reset links are inert GET landing pages whose tokens are consumed atomically only by explicit POST actions; resets do not create sessions, successful resets prove the mailbox, registration mail failure leaves no orphan account, and administrator welcome-mail failure cannot misreport a successfully created user.

Authentication errors remain adjacent to the active form, completed email and reset flows retain a persistent outcome with a clear return to login, password confirmation is enforced before token consumption, and loading states continue through the fork's existing Vuetify loader.

Production administration does not ship a browser-driven sample generator or purge every page carrying a generic test tag; disposable content belongs in isolated fixtures with an ownership marker and one atomic lifecycle.

The fork retains Express, Objection, its existing Nodemailer template pipeline, Vuetify, and locale namespaces; Scarlett Fastify schemas, Drizzle models, Tailwind components, duplicate mail renderer, and multisite strategy IDs are not transplanted.
